column1: # LERENA AND LLERENA, ALTERNATING FOR ONE MAN - the test hypothesis 1 asked for.
# Sources attached to Sancho Llerena Aguilar (FamilySearch Tree LHJP-D1Y, b. Cordoba 1767,
# d. 1832, m. Canelones 1791), every one of them in "Uruguay, registros parroquiales, 1726-2000".
# Listed exactly as the source titles render his name. Read 13 September 2026.
# *** TIER: the ATTACHMENTS are secondary - a tree user decided these fourteen records are all
# the same man, and the underlying acts have NOT been opened here. What is primary and checkable
# is that the Uruguayan parish registers of one city spell this name BOTH WAYS across forty years.
# NOTE the 1828 form: "Sancho DE Llerena" - the toponymic construction, "of Llerena", which is
# how the Badajoz town-name behaves as a surname. It is the strongest single form in the list.
